title: Americans are turning against Trump's handling of economy, prices
summary_full: Poll results reveal widespread dissatisfaction among Americans regarding Donald Trump's management of the economy and inflation. Many citizens express concerns about the increasing cost of essentials like food and fuel. A significant majority believe Trump’s policies contribute to these financial challenges, as his economic approval ratings have sharply declined. Sparticularly, Trump's handling of trade tariffs and the war with Iran is under scrutiny.
